title: TransBench: Benchmarking Machine Translation for Industrial-Scale Applications
findings: The paper establishes the importance of evaluating a model's ability to handle religious taboos (e.g., blasphemy in Islamic contexts) as a key component of 'Cultural Fidelity' for industrial-scale machine translation. It introduces a 'Taboo Words Dataset' specifically for this purpose but does not present comparative results of different models on this task.
